The table and chairs are clustered within roughly 1–3 m of that person, with items on the tabletop within their arm’s reach, while none of the camp objects is initially within the camera wearer’s arm’s reach. Across the five frames, the camera wearer approaches the person and table and turns right, making the person grow larger and shift from centre to the right foreground while the truck shifts from the right edge to the left background. The person turns partly leftward in the final frames, remaining mostly in profile or facing the table; their lower body is intermittently blocked by the table, and the truck, tent, chairs, cliff tops, and nearby objects are partly cut off at different image edges as the viewpoint rotates.
